Inventory Oficer Job at Kenedri Services




        
    

        
        Kenedri Services - We are into recruitment for companies and we are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Inventory Oficer
Job Location: Rivers
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	The Inventory Officer will be responsible for managing stock levels, recording stock movements, conducting stock counts, monitoring expiry dates, and ensuring the efficient use and availability of inventory.


Key Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Maintain accurate records of raw materials, finished products, packaging materials, and store items.
	Receive, inspect, record, and properly store incoming supplies.
	Monitor stock levels and initiate replenishment when necessary.
	Record stock issued to production and retail operations.
	Conduct regular physical stock counts and reconcile stock variances.
	Monitor expiry dates and ensure proper FIFO (First-In, First-Out) practices.
	Identify damaged, expired, missing, or slow-moving stock and report to management.
	Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly inventory reports.
	Monitor wastage and unusual stock consumption.
	Maintain an organized and hygienic storage area.
	Work with the Cost Accountant and management to improve stock control and reduce losses.


Requirements


	Possess an OND / HND / B.Sc. in Accounting, Business Administration, Supply Chain, Inventory Management, or a related field with 2 – 3 years of Inventory / Store Management experience.
	Good knowledge of stock management procedures.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or inventory management software.
	Strong organizational and record-keeping skills.
	Ability to conduct accurate stock counts.
	Experience in a bakery, confectionery, supermarket, restaurant, or FMCG environment is an advantage


Salary
N100,00 - N150,000 monthly.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the  Job Position as subject of the mail.

{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Digital Marketing Specialist",
  "description": "Uniccon Group is the home of innovative and customizable tech products to meet your needs. We combine world-class expertise, experience, and modern tools to scale up your productivity. Valuing and collaborating for the best services have kept us ahead of the market. Individuals, SMEs, organisation, and government agencies achieve more with us.

Uniccon Group owns Africa&rsquo;s leading hub for STEM research, training, and solutions (STEMFocus). Research is the bedrock of our innovative services in the marketplace, payment gateway, workflow optimization, financial intel, cybersecurity, cloud infrastructure, and e-learning products. We are futuristic and leading with METAVERSE and NFTs in Africa. The operations extend to Agro-commodities processing and export, fashion brands, and general contracting business. It oversees operations across Africa, Asia, Europe, the Americas, and other parts of the world. The products are innovative, and customizable to meet market needs. Unicorn Group is a key player in their respective industries.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Digital Marketing Specialist

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-Time

Core Purpose


	To build and manage a lean, high-performing growth engine.
	This role owns paid and organic acquisition, app store optimization (ASO), conversion funnels, and retention campaigns to cost-effectively drive user acquisition and revenue.


Key Responsibilities &amp; Deliverables
